pages.title: Fire with a Catch
pages.text: Apply Magmadermis to a weapon or shield and trigger its real combat effect.

pages.title: Fire with a Catch
pages.text: Match a fire coating to a burning target and shield durability cost.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The weapon gains damage against burning targets but loses against others. The shield can ignite an attacker while blocking at a durability cost. Check the workshop for material and application.
